summary: Apply ISO 30415, assess workforce data, and build a DEI action plan. Explore this five-day intermediate course and request course details.
lede: Workplace DEI training helps HR business partners, DEI leads, and people managers turn inclusion priorities into practical, measurable actions. Participants review workforce representation and employee-lifecycle barriers, assess inclusive recruitment and accessibility, and build accountable action plans and progress dashboards using Excel, with reference to ISO 30415 and GRI 405. The course also covers operational review of AI-assisted screening and human-review checkpoints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape workplace policies, analyse employee experience, or are responsible for turning DEI commitments into measurable action.
modules: Inclusion, Voice, and UN Guiding Principles
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, people management, organizational development, employee relations, or a related workplace role is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing workplace policies or employee information. No coding or programming is required; exercises use Excel and illustrative data.
